summary: Agent promised a shipping refund and offered to delay delivery before pulling up the account and completing required verification. No other policy violations were found.

findings.quote: I will, but firstly the best thing I can do is refund you for the shipping.
findings.explanation: The agent promises a shipping refund before the account was pulled up (the system logs show the account was pulled up at turn 24) and before full verification. Policy requires the agent to pull up the account and perform full verification (username, email address and order ID) before refunds/returns are promised or processed.

findings.quote: Oh no, my apologies! I can delay the delivery.
findings.explanation: The agent offers to delay the delivery before pulling up the account and completing verification. Policy states that before any account or order action the agent must first pull up the account and perform required verification.
